name: quiet-tools
description: A switch that hides the tool rows in the transcript (Bash, Read, Edit and the rest) so you read only the conversation. Works alone or inside side-stack.

start_on.title: Start with tool rows hidden
start_on.description: Hide tool rows from the first session, before you ever press the switch. Off by default. Once you use /quiet or the switch, your last choice is kept instead. The start_on key in ~/.config/quiet-tools/config.json, when true or false, wins over this.

show_errors.title: Keep failed tool rows visible
show_errors.description: While tool rows are hidden, still show a tool call that failed, and its error. On by default. The show_errors key in ~/.config/quiet-tools/config.json, when true or false, wins over this.
